text.body: <1> ekaṃ jñānaṃ nityamādyantaśūnyaṃ nānyatkiñcidvatte te vastu satyam yadbhedosminnindriyopādhinā vai jñānasyāyaṃ bhāsate nānyathaiva 1 atha bhaktānurakto'haṃ vakti yogānuśāsanam īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāmātmamuktipradāyakaḥ 2 tyaktvā vivādaśīlānāṃ mataṃ durlānahetukam ālpajñānāya bhūtānāmananyagaticetasām 3 satyaṃ kecitpraśaṃsanti tapaḥ śaucaṃ tathāpare kṣamāṃ kecitpaśasati tathaiva samamārjavam 4 keciddānaṃ praśaṃsanti pitṛkarma tathāpare kecitkarma praśaṃsanti kecidvairāvayamuttamam 5 kecidgahasthakarmāṇi praśaṃsanti vicakṣaṇāḥ agnehotrādikaṃ karma tathā kecitparaṃ viduḥ 6 mantrayogaṃ praśaṃsanti kecittīrthānusevanam evaṃ bahunupāyāṃstu pravadanti hi muktaye 7 evaṃ vyavasitā loke kṛtyākṛtyavido janāḥ vyāmohameva gacchati vimuktāḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ 8 etanmatāvalambī yo labdhvā duritapuyayake bhramatītyavaśaḥ so'tra janmamṛtyuparamparām 9 anyairmatimatāṃ śreṣṭhairguptālokanatatparaiḥ ātsāno bahavaḥ proktā nityāḥ sarvagatāstathā 10 yadyatpatyakṣaviṣaya tadanyatrāsti cakṣate kutaḥ svargādayaḥ santītyanye niścitamānasāḥ 11 jñānapravāha ityanye śūnyaṃ kecitparaṃ viduḥ dvāveva tattvaṃ manyante'pare prakṛtipūruṣau 12 atyantabhinnamatayaḥ paramārthaparāṣṭuravāḥ evamanye tu saṃcintya yathāmati yathāśrutam 13 nirīśvaramidaṃ prāhuḥ seśvarañca tathāpare vadanti vividhairthedaiḥ suyuktyā sthitikātarāḥ 14 ete cānye ca munayaḥ saṃjñābhedā pṛthagvidhāḥ śāstreṣu kathitā hyete lokavyāmohakārakāḥ 15 etadvivādaśīlānāṃ mataṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate bhramantyasmiñjanāḥ sarve muktimārgabahiṣkatāḥ 16 ālokya sarvaśāstrāṇi vicārya ca punaḥ punaḥ idamekaṃ suniṣpannaṃ yogaśāstraṃ paraṃ matam 17 yasmin yāte sarvamidaṃ yātaṃ bhavati niścitam tasminyariśramaḥ kāryaḥ kimanyacchāstrabhāṣitam 18 yogaśāstramidaṃ gopyamasmābhiḥ paribhāṣitam subhaktāya pradātavyaṃ trailokye ca mahātmane 19 karmakāṇḍaṃ jñānakāyaḍamiti vedo dvidhā mataḥ bhavati dvividho bhedo jñānakāyaḍasya karmaṇaḥ 20 dvividhaḥ karmakāyaḍaḥ khyāviṣedhavidhipūrvakaḥ 21 niṣiddhakarmakaraṇe pāpaṃ bhavati niścitam vidhinā karmakaro puyayaṃ bhavati niścitam 22 trividho vidhikūṭaḥ khyāvityanaimittakāmyataḥ nitye'kṛte kilviṣaṃ khyātkāmye naimittike phalam 23 dvitridhantu phalaṃ jñeyaṃ svargo naraka eva ca svargo nānāvidhaścaiva narakopi tathā bhavet 24 puyayakarmāṇi vai svargo narakaḥ pāpakarmāṇi karmavaṃdhamayī sṛṣṭirnānyathā bhavati dhruvam 25 jantubhiścānubhūyaṃte svarge nānāsukhāni ca nānāvidhāni dukhāni narake duḥsahāni vai 26 pāpakarmavaśādurava puyayakarmavaśātsukham tasmātsukhārthī vividhaṃ puyayaṃ prakurute dhruvam 27 pāpabhogāvasāne tu punarjanma bhavetkhalu puyayabhogāvasāne ta nānyathā bhavati dhruvam 28 svarge'pi duravasaṃbhogaḥ paraśrīdarśanādiṣu tato duḥkhamidaṃ sarvaṃ bhavennāstvatra saṃśayaḥ 29 tatkarmakalpakaiḥ proktaṃ puyayaṃ pāpamiti dvidhā puyayapāpamayo bandho dehināṃ bhavati kramāt 30 ihāmutra phaladveṣī saphalaṃ karma saṃtyajet nityanaimittikaṃ saṃjña tyaktvā yoge pravartate 31 karmakāṇḍasya māhātmyaṃ jñātvā yogī tyajetsudhīḥ puyayapāpadvayaṃ tyaktvā jñānakāṇḍe pravartate 32 ātsā vā'retu draṣṭavyaḥ śrotavyetyādi yacchrutiḥ sā sevyā tatprayatnena muktidā hetudāyinī 33 duriteṣu ca purāyeṣu yo dhīrvṛttiṃ pracodayāt so'haṃ pravartate matto jagatsarvaṃ carācaram sarvaṃ ca dṛśyate mattaḥ sarvaṃ ca mayi līyate na tajjito'hamasmahi majjito na tu kiṃcana 34 jalapūrṇeṣvasaṃkhyeṣu śarāveṣu yathā bhavet ekasya bhātyasaṃkhyatvaṃ tadvedo'tra na dṛśyate upādhiṣu śarāveṣu yā saṃkhyā vartate parā sā saṃkhyā bhavati yathā ravau cātmani tattathā 35 yathaikaḥ kalpakaḥ svapne nānāvidhitayeṣyate jāgarepi tathāpyekastathaiva bahudhā jagat 36 sarpabuddhiryathā rajau śuktau vā rajatabhramaḥ tadvadevamidaṃ viśvaṃ vivṛtaṃ paramātmani 37 rajujñānādyathā sarpo mithyārūpo nivartate ālpajñānāttathā yāti mithyābhūtamidaṃ jagat 38 raupyabhrāntiriyaṃ yāti śuktijñānādyathā khalu jagadbhrāntiriyaṃ yāti cākṣṇajñānātsadā tathā 39 yathā vaṃśo ragabhrāntirbhavendrekavasāñjanāt tathā jagadidaṃ bhrātirabhyāsakalpanāñjanāt 40 ālpajñānādyathā nāsti rajujñānātyujahamaḥ yathā doṣavaśācchuccaḥ pīto bhavati nānyathā ajñānadoṣādātsāpi jagadbhavati dustyajam 41 doṣanāśe yathā śuklo gṛhyate gaugarayā svayam śukyājñānāttathā'jñānanāśādātsā tathā kṛtaḥ 42 kālatrayepi na yathā rajjuḥ sarpo bhavediti tathātmā na bhavedviśvaṃ guṇātīto nirañjanaḥ 43 āgamā'pāyino'nityānāśyatveneśvarādayaḥ ālpabodhena kenāpi śāstrādetadviniścitam 44 yathā vātavaśājjvindhāvutpannāḥ phenabudbudāḥ tathātmani samudbhūtaṃ saṃsāraṃ kṣaṇabhaṃguram 45 abhedo bhāsate nityaṃ vastubhedo na bhāsate dvidhātridhādithedo'yaṃ bhramatve paryavasyati 46 yadbhūtaṃ yañca bhāvyaṃ vai mūrtāmūrtaṃ tathaiva ca sarvameva jagadidaṃ vivṛtaṃ paramātmani 47 kalpakaiḥ kalpitā vidyā mithyā jātā mṛṣāṣmikā etanmūlaṃ jagadidaṃ kathaṃ satyaṃ bhaviṣyati 48 caitanyātsarvamutpatraṃ jagadetañcarācaram tasmātsarvaṃ parityajya caitanyaṃ taṃ samāśrayet 49 ghaṭakhyāñjayatare bāhye yathākāśaṃ pravartate tathātsābhyatare bāhye kāryavargeṣu nityaśaḥ 50 asaṃlagnaṃ yathākāśaṃ mithyābhūteṣu paṃcasu asaṃlamastathātsā tu kāryavargeṣu nānyathā 51 īśvarādijagatsarvamātyatayāpya samantataḥ eko'sti sañcidānadaḥ pūrṇo dvaitavivarjitaḥ 52 yasmātpakāśako nāsti svaprakāśo bhavettataḥ svaprakāśo yatastasmādātsā jyotiḥ svarupakaḥ 53 avachitro yato nāsti deśakālasvarupataḥ ālpanaḥ sarvathā tasmādātmā pūrṇo bhavetkhalu 54 yasmānna vidyate nāśaḥ pacabhūtairvṛthālpakaiḥ tasmādātmā bhavennityastannāśo na bhavetavalu 55 yasmāttadanyo nāstīha tasmādeko'sti sarvadā yasmāttadanyo mithyā syādātmā satyo bhavet khalu 56 avidyābhūtasaṃsāre duravanāśe sukhaṃ yataḥ jñānādādyataśūnya khyāttasmādātsā bhavetsukham 57 yasmānnāśitamajñānaṃ jñānena viśvakāraragam tasmādātmā bhavejjñānaṃ jñānaṃ tasmātsanātanam 58 kālato vividhaṃ viśvaṃ yadā caiva bhavedidam tadeko'sti sa evātmā kalpanāpathavarjitaḥ 59 bāhyāni sarvabhūtāni vināśaṃ yānti kālataḥ yato vāco nivarttate ātsā dvaitavivarjitaḥ 60 na khaṃ vāyurna cāgniśca na jalaṃ pṛthivī na ca naitatkāryaṃ neśvarādi pūrṇaikātsā bhavetavalu 61 ālpānamālpano yogī paśyatyātmani niścitam sarvasaṃkalpasaṃnyāsī tyaktamithyābhavayahaḥ 62 ālpānālpani cātmānaṃ dṛṣṭvānantaṃ sukhātmakam vismṛtya viśvaṃ ramate samādhestīvatastathā 63 māyaiva viśvajananī nānyā tattvadhiyāparā yadā nāśaṃ samāyāti viśvaṃ nāsti tadā khalu 64 heyaṃ sarvamidaṃ yasya māyāvilasitaṃ yataḥ tato na prītiviṣayasānuvittasuravālpakaḥ 65 arirmitramudāsīnastrividhaṃ syādidaṃ jagat vyavahāreṣu niyataṃ dṛśyate nānyathā punaḥ priyāpriyādithedastu vastuṣu niyataḥ sphuṭam 66 ātsopādhivaśādeva bhavetputrādi nānyathā māyāvilasitaṃ viśvaṃ jñātvaivaṃ śrutiyuktitaḥ adhyāropāpavādābhyāṃ layaṃ kurvanti yoginaḥ 67 nikhilopādhihīno vai yadā bhavati pūruṣaḥ tadā vivakṣate'ravaḍaśānarūpī niraṃjanaḥ 68 so kāmayataḥ puruṣaḥ sṛjate ca prajāḥ svayam avidyā bhāsate yasmāttasmānmithyā svabhāvataḥ 69 śuddha bahyatva saṃbaddho vidyayā sahito bhavet brahyatenasatī yāti yata ābhāsate nabhaḥ 70 tasmātpakāśate vāyurvāyoragnistato jalam prakāśate tataḥ pṛdhvī kalpaneyaṃ sthitā sati 71 ākāśādvāyurākāśapavanādagnisaṃbhavaḥ ravavātāyerjalaṃ vyomavātāgnivārito mahī 72 khaṃ śabdalakṣaṇaṃ vāyuścacalaḥ stharśalakṣaṇaḥ khyādrūpalakṣaṇaṃ tejaḥ salilaṃ rasalakṣaṇam gandhalakṣaṇikā pṛdhvī nānyathā bhavati dhruvam 73 khyādekaguṇamākāśaṃ dviguṇo vāyurucyate tathaiva triguṇaṃ tejo bhavantyāpaścaturguṇāḥ śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhastathaiva ca etatpacaguṇā pṛdhvī kalpakaiḥ kaktyate'dhunā 74 cakṣuṣā gṛhyate rūpaṃ gandho vāṇena gṛhyate raso rasanayā stharśastvacā saṃgṛhyate param 75 śrotreṇa gṛhyate śabdo niyataṃ bhāti nānyathā 76 caitanyātsarvamutpatraṃ jagadetañcarācaram asti cetkalpaneyaṃ syānnāsti cedasti cinmayam 77 pṛdhvī śīrṇā jale mamā jalaṃ mayañca tejasi līnaṃ vāyau tathā tejo vyomni vāto layaṃ yayau avidyāyāṃ mahākāśo līyate parame pade 78 vikṣepāvaraṇā śaktirdurantāsuravarūpiṇī jaḍarūpā mahāmāyā rajasattvatamoguṇā 79 sā māyāvaraṇāśaktyāvṛtāvijñānarūpiṇī darśayejagadākāraṃ taṃ vikṣepasvabhāvataḥ 80 tamo guṇādhikā vidyā yā sā durgāṃ bhavet svayam īśvarastadupahitaṃ caitanyaṃ tadaccūdhruvam sattādhikā ca yā vidyā lakṣmīḥ khyāddivyarūpiṇī caitanyaṃ tadupahitaṃ ovasturbhavati nānyathā 81 rajoguṇādhikā vidyā jñeyā sā vai sarasvatī yaściktyaruṣo bhavati brahmātadupadhārakaḥ 82 īśādyāḥ sakalā devā dṛśyante paramātmani śarīrādijaḍaṃ sarvaṃ sā vidyā tattathā tathā 83 evaṃrūpeṇa kalpante kalpakā viśvasambhavam tattvātattvaṃ bhavatīha kalpanānyena coditā 84 prameyatvādirūpeṇa sarvaṃ vastu prakāśyate viśeṣaśabdopādāne bhedo bhavati nānyathā 85 tathaiva vastunāstyeva bhāsako vartakaḥ paraḥ svarūpatvena rūpeṇa svarupaṃ vastu bhāṣyate 86 ekaḥ sattāpūritānandarūpaḥ pūrṇo vyāpī vartate nāsti kiñcit etajjñānaṃ yaḥ karotyeva nityaṃ muktaḥ sa khyābhyutyusaṃsāraduravāt 87 yakhyāropāpavādābhyāṃ yatra sarve layaṃ gatāḥ sa eko vartate nānyattañcittenāvadhāryate 88 pituratramayātkośājāyate pūrvakarmaṇaḥ taccharīravidurdurava svaprācyogāya sundaram 89 māsāsthisrāyumajādinirmitaṃ bhogamandiram kevalaṃ duravabhogāya nāḍī satatigulphitam 90 pārameṣṭhaghamidaṃ gātraṃ paṃcabhūtavinirmitam bahyāyaḍasaṃjñakaṃ duravasukhabhogāya kalpitam 91 binduḥ śivo rajaḥ śaktirugnayormilanāktyayam svamabhūtāni jāyante svaśaktyā jaḍarūpayā 92 tatpañcīkaraṇāktyūlānyasaṃkhyāni samāsataḥ brahyāṃḍasthāni vastūni yatra jīvo'sti karmabhiḥ tadbhūtapañcakātsarvaṃ bhogāya jīvasaṃjñitā 93 pūrvakarmānurodhena karomi ghaṭanāmaham ajaḍaḥ sarvabhūtasthā jaḍasthityā bhunakti tān 94 jaḍāktyakarmabhirbaddho jīvāratayo vividho bhavet bhogāyotpadyate karma brahyāṃḍākhye punaḥ punaḥ 95 jīvaśca līyate bhogāvasāne ca svakarma 96 iti prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ <2> dehe'sminvartate meruḥ saptadvīpasamanvitaḥ saritaḥ sāgarāḥ śailāḥ kṣetrāṇi kṣetrapālakāḥ 1 ṛṣayo munayaḥ sarve nakṣatrāṇi grahāstathā puyayatīrthāni pīṭhāni vartante pīudevatāḥ 2 sṛṣṭisaṃhārakartārau bhramantau śaśibhāskarau nabho vāyuśca vandiśca jalaṃ pṛdhvī tathaiva ca 3 trailokye yāni bhūtāni tāni sarvāṇi dehataḥ meruṃ saṃveṣṭya sarvatra vyavahāraḥ pravartate 4 jānāti yaḥ sarvamidaṃ sa yogī nātra saṃśayaḥ 5 bahyāyaḍasaṃjñake dehe yathādeśaṃ vyavasthitaḥ suśṛhe sudhāraśmirbahiraṣṭakalāyutaḥ 6 vartate'harniśaṃ so'pi sudhāṃ varṣatyadhomuravaḥ tato'mṛtaṃ dvidhābhūtaṃ yāti sūkṣmaṃ yathā ca vai 7 iḍāmārgeṇa puṣṭyarthaṃ yāti mandākinījalam puṣṇāti sakalaṃ dehamiḍāmārgeṇa niścitam 8 eṣa pīyūṣaraśmirhi vāmapārśve vyavasthitaḥ aparaḥ śuddhadugdhābho haḍhātkarṣati maṇḍalāt madhyamārgeṇa sṛṣṭyarthaṃ merau saṃyāti candramāḥ 9 merumūle sthitaḥ sūryaḥ kalādvādaśasaṃyutaḥ dakṣiṇe pathi raśmibhirvahatyūrdhvaṃ prajāpatiḥ 10 pīyūṣaraśminiryāsaṃ dhātūṃśca cāsati dhruvam samīramaṇḍale sūryo bhramate sarvaviyahe 11 eṣā sūryaparāmūrtiḥ nirvāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe pathi vahate jñaprayogena sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ 12 sārdhalakṣatrayaṃ nāḍyaḥ santi dehāntare nṛṇām pradhānabhūtā nāḍyastu tāsu mukhyāścaturdaśaḥ 13 suṣumyegaḍā oṣagalā ca gāṃdhārī hastijihnikā kuhūḥ sarasvatī pūṣā śaṃkhinī ca payasvanī 14 vāruyayalambusā caiva viśvodarī yaśasvinī etāsu tisro mukhyayā, syuḥ piḍvaleḍā suṣundriyakā 15 tisṛṣvekā suṣumyaigava mukhyā sāyogivallabhā anyāstadāśrayaṃ kṛtvā nāḍyaḥ santi hi dehinām 16 nāḍacastu tā adhovakyāḥ padyatantunibhāḥ sthitāḥ pṛṣṭhavaṃśaṃ samāśritya somasūryāgnirūpiṇī 17 tāsāṃ madhye gatā nāḍī citrā sā mama vallabhā brahyarandhañca tatraiva sūkṣmātsūkṣmataraṃ śubham 18 pañcavarṇoñjalā śuddhā suṣumyagā madhyacāriṇī dehakhyopādhirūpā sā suṣumyagā madhyarūpiṇī 19 divyamārgamidaṃ proktamamṛtānandakārakam dhyānamātreṇa yogīdro duritaugha vināśayet 20 gudāttudvyaṃgulādūrdhvaṃ mesvāttu dvyaṃgulādadhaḥ caturaṃgagulavistāramāśrāraṃ vartate samam 21 tasmikadhārapadye ca karṇikāyāṃ suśobhanā trikoṇā varttate yoniḥ sarvajeṣu gopitā 22 tatra vidyahvātākārā kuṇḍalī paradevatā sārddhatrikarā kuṭilā suṣumyagā mārgasaṃsthitā 23 jagatsaṃsṛṣṭirūpā sā nirmāṇe satatodyatā vācāmavācyā vāvadevī sadā devairnamaskṛtā 24 iḍānāgnī tu yā nāḍī vāmamārge vyavasthitā suṣumyagāyāṃ samāśliṣya dakṣanāsāpuṭe gatā 25 piṅgalā nāma yā nāḍī dakṣamārge vyavasthitā madhyanāḍīṃ samāśliṣya vāmanāsāpuṭe gatā 26 iḍāpiṃgalayormadhye suṣumyagā yā bhavetkhalu ṣaṭsthāneṣu ca ṣaṭśakti ṣaṭpadya yogino viduḥ 27 paṃcasthānaṃ suṣumyagāyā nāmāni khyurbahūni ca prayojanavaśāttāni jñātavyānīha śāstrataḥ 28 anyā yā'stvaparā nāḍī mūlādhārātsamutthitā rasanāmeḍhranayanaṃ pādāṃguṣṭhe ca śrotrakam kukṣikakṣāguṣṭhakarṇaṃ sarvāṅgaṃ pāyukukṣikam labdhvā tāṃ vai nivartante yathādeśasamudbhavāḥ 29 etābhya eva nāḍībhyaḥ śāravopaśākhataḥ kramāt sārdhalakṣatrayaṃ jātaṃ yathābhāgaṃ vyavasthitam 30 etā bhogavahā nāḍyo vāyusañcāradakṣakāḥ otaprotāḥ susaṃvyāpya tiṣṭhantyasmicchalevare 31 sūryamaṇḍalamadhyasthaḥ kalādvādaśasaṃyutaḥ vastideśe jvaladvahnirvartate cānnapācakaḥ eṣa vaiśvānarognirvai mama tejoṃśasasthavaḥ karoti vividhaṃ pākaṃ prāṇināṃ dehamāsthitaḥ 32 āyuḥ pradāyako vahnirbalaṃ puṣṭiṃ dadāti saḥ śarīrapāṭavañcāpi dhvastarogasamuvyavaḥ 33 tasmādvaiśvānarāyiñca prajvālya vidhivatsudhīḥ tasminnatraṃ hunedyogī pratyahaṃ guruśikṣayā 34 bahyāyaḍasaṃjñake dehe sthānāni khyurbahūni ca mayoktāni pradhānāni jñātavyānīha śāstrake 35 nānāprakāranāmāni sthānāni vividhāni ca vartante vigrahe tāni kathituṃ naiva śakyate 36 itthaṃ prakalpite dehe jīvo vasati sarjjaṇaḥ anādivāsanāmālā'laṃkṛtaḥ karmaśaravalaḥ 37 nānāvidhaguṇopetaḥ sarvalayāpārakārakaḥ pūrvārjitāni karmāṇi bhunakti vividhāni ca 38 yadyatsaṃdṛśyate loke sarvaṃ tatkarmasasthavam sarvā karmānusāreṇa janturbhogānmunakti vai 39 ye ye kāmādayo doṣāḥ suravaduravapradāyakāḥ te te sarve pravartante jīvakarmānusārataḥ 40 puyayoparaktacaitanye prāṇānmīṇāti kevalam
